public.text: The intended audiences are clearly described, but civil-society organisations, community health representatives and academic institutions are not listed, although they are important to implementation, accountability, trust, capacity-building and community engagement in countries such as Mozambique.
public.suggestedRevision: Add an audience category for civil society, community representatives and academic institutions, explaining their roles in inclusive governance, implementation research, workforce development, public accountability and the translation of community needs into national digital-health priorities.
